# Data Extraction

RRF reference data are sourced from the US FDA Chemicals List for Analytical Performance (CLAP) — <https://cdrh-rst.fda.gov/chemicals-list-analytical-performance-clap>. Three datasets (GC/MS, LC/MS positive-ion, LC/MS negative-ion) were extracted from the corresponding PDFs and stored as Excel workbooks. Non-detected values were set to 0 and values reported as below the detection limit were set to 0.001, following Subject Matter Expert (SME) guidance. All three datasets are loaded in every simulation file to maintain cross-technique comparability; only the dataset relevant to this scenario is sampled in the Monte Carlo loop.

```{r}
#| message: false
# ── GC/MS RRF data (CLAP) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Source: RRF GCMS for CLAP.pdf  →  processed_data/GCMS.xlsx  (sheet "GC-MS")
gcms_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_GCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "GC-MS")
gcms_clap_clean <- gcms_clap %>% na.omit()
gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"  <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL")
gcms_clap_clean$"10 µg/mL" <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"10 µg/mL")
gcms_clap_clean$"20 µg/mL" <- as.numeric(gcms_clap_clean$"20 µg/mL")

# ── LC/MS positive-ion RRF data (CLAP) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Source: LCMS RRFs CLAP Positive Ion Detection.pdf  →  processed_data/LCMS.xlsx  (sheet "LCMSPOS")
lcmspos_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSPOS")
lcmspos_clap_clean <- lcmspos_clap %>% na.omit()

# ── LC/MS negative-ion RRF data (CLAP) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Source: LCMS RRFs CLAP Negative Ion Detection.pdf  →  processed_data/LCMS.xlsx  (sheet "LCMSNEG")
lcmsneg_clap       <- read_excel(path = "../../data/processed/CLAP_LCMS_clean.xlsx", sheet = "LCMSNEG")
lcmsneg_clap_clean <- lcmsneg_clap %>% na.omit()

# Dataset size check
# Each simulation iteration draws N_extractables = 80 compounds WITHOUT replacement;
# the relevant column must contain at least 80 non-missing entries.
cat(sprintf("GC/MS:   %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(gcms_clap_clean)))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS+:  %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(lcmspos_clap_clean)))
cat(sprintf("LC/MS-:  %d compounds (3 surrogate concentrations)\n", nrow(lcmsneg_clap_clean)))
```

# Simulation parameters

```{r}
# Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET) in µg/mL
AET <- 0.45
fig_tag <- "GCMS_5ug_AET045"
```

# Scenario: Log-Normal Concentration Distribution (GC/MS-Fitted: $\mu=-2.4$, $\sigma=4.6$) with Empirical GC/MS RRFs (5 µg/mL Surrogate)

This notebook presents Monte Carlo simulation results quantifying the classification bias introduced by Relative Response Factors (RRFs) in GC/MS extractables and leachables (E&L) studies. In each iteration, 80 hypothetical extractable compounds are drawn from a chosen concentration distribution, their measured concentrations are distorted by an RRF, and each compound is classified as at or above / below the Analytical Evaluation Threshold (AET). Several uncertainty-factor (UF) correction strategies are then evaluated against the baseline (no correction) using standard classification metrics.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Simulation design

| Parameter | Value |
|----|----|
| **Analytical technique** | GC/MS |
| **Surrogate concentration** | **5 µg/mL** |
| **Concentration distribution (Conc ID 2)** | Log-Normal fitted from an actual **GC/MS** extractables study ($\mu_{\log} = -2.4$, $\sigma_{\log} = 4.6$); represents a realistic, study-derived concentration distribution. |
| **RRF distribution (RRF ID A)** | Empirical — non-parametric bootstrap (sampling without replacement) from the GC/MS section of the US FDA CLAP list, at a surrogate concentration of **5 µg/mL**. This approach preserves the real-world dispersion of detector response factors. |
| **AET** | 0.45 µg/mL |
| **Iterations** (`N_sim`) | 10,000 |
| **Compounds per iteration** (`N_extractables`) | 80 |
| **Correction strategies** | No correction; UF = 2; UF = 4; UF = 10; UF(RSD); UF(RSD, filtered); UF(mean·RSD, filtered); UF(mean·RSD); µ/Percentile (16th); Percentile 10th; Percentile 20th; RRFlow; RRF\<1; Machine Learning |
| **Performance metrics** | FNR, FPR, F₁, F_β (β = 5) |

The UF formulas follow ISO 10993-18. The **False Negative Rate (FNR)** quantifies under-reporting risk (compounds truly ≥ AET that are missed), while the **False Positive Rate (FPR)** quantifies over-reporting.
:::

## Initialisation of the comparison table

```{r}
# Accumulates one row per correction method; populated in the loops below.
# Columns: method label, mean FNR/FPR and their binomial SDs, precision, recall,
#          F1, F-beta (beta=5) across all N_sim iterations.
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Method = character(),
  FN_Rate = numeric(),   # False Negative Rate  (proportion of truly ≥ AET missed)
  FP_Rate = numeric(),   # False Positive Rate  (proportion of truly < AET over-reported)
  FN_SD = numeric(),     # Binomial SD of FNR
  FP_SD = numeric(),     # Binomial SD of FPR
  precision = numeric(), # TP / (TP + FP)
  recall = numeric(),    # TP / (TP + FN)  — same as sensitivity / true-positive rate
  F1 = numeric(),        # Harmonic mean of precision and recall
  f_beta = numeric()    # F-beta score (beta = 5: strongly weights recall over precision)
)
# Stores the per-iteration metric distributions for violin / density plots.
all_distributions <- data.frame()
```

## Baseline: No RRF Correction

```{r}
set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0
dist_f1 <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_f5 <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_fnr <- numeric(N_sim)
dist_fpr <- numeric(N_sim)
beta <- 5

for (i in 1:N_sim) {
## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.6)
simulated_RRF <- sample(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL", size = N_extractables, replace = FALSE)
corrected_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF

is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "No Correction",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF =  1
  )
)
metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "No Correction",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

## Uncertainty-Factor (UF) Corrections — ISO 10993-18

```{r}
# RSD of the full (unfiltered) RRF dataset — used in the ISO 10993-18 UF formula
rsd_all <- function(x) {
  return(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# RSD of the filtered RRF dataset (0.05 < RRF ≤ 1) — avoids negative UF from extreme outliers
rsd_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use = x[x<=1&x>0.05]
  return(sd(x_use, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}
# Mean of the filtered RRF dataset — used in the extended UF(mean·RSD) formula
mean_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use <- x[x <= 1 & x > 0.05]
  return(mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}


set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

UF_RSD <- 1/(1 - rsd_all(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL")) # formula from ISO 10993-18

UF_RSD_filtered <- 1/(1 - rsd_filtered(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"))  # case to avoid negative rsd
UF_meanRSD_filtered <- 1/(mean_filtered(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL") * (1 - rsd_filtered(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"))) # derived formula from ISO 10993-18 with mean (filtered 0.05-1)

UF_meanRSD <- 1/(mean(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL", na.rm = TRUE) * (1 - rsd_all(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"))) # derived formula from ISO 10993-18 with mean

UF_list <- c(
  "UF (2)"   = 2, 
  "UF (4)"   = 4,
  "UF (10)"  = 10, 
  "UF (RSD)" = UF_RSD,
  "UF (RSD filtered)" = UF_RSD_filtered,
  "UF (µRSD filtered)" = UF_meanRSD_filtered,

  "UF (µRSD)"    = UF_meanRSD

)

N_extractables <- 80

for (m_name in names(UF_list)) {
  uf_val <- UF_list[[m_name]]
  total_FN <- 0
  total_FP <- 0
  total_TP <- 0
  total_TN <- 0
  
  
for (i in 1:N_sim) {
## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.6)
simulated_RRF <- sample(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL", size = N_extractables, replace = FALSE)
  
  exp_conc <- (base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF)
  corrected_conc <- exp_conc * uf_val 
  
  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = m_name,
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF =  uf_val
  )
)
metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = m_name,
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)
}

UF_RSD

UF_RSD_filtered

UF_meanRSD_filtered

UF_meanRSD


```

## Correction Factor mean/16th percentile

```{r}
percentile <- function(x) {
  return(quantile(x, .16))
}

set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

RRF_GCMS_superior0 <- gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"
RRF_GCMS_superior0 <- RRF_GCMS_superior0[RRF_GCMS_superior0 > 0]

meanGCMS <- mean(RRF_GCMS_superior0)
percentileGCMS <- percentile(RRF_GCMS_superior0)

for (i in 1:N_sim) {
## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.6)
simulated_RRF <- sample(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL", size = N_extractables, replace = FALSE)

exp_conc <- (base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF)
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * (meanGCMS / percentileGCMS)

is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

  iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "µ/Percentile (16th)",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = (meanGCMS / percentileGCMS)
  )
)
metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "µ/Percentile (16th)",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

## Correction RRFlow

```{r}


# RSD of the filtered RRF dataset (0.05 < RRF ≤ 1) — avoids negative UF from extreme outliers
rsd_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use = x[x<=1&x>0.05]
  return(sd(x_use, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}
# Mean of the filtered RRF dataset — used in the extended UF(mean·RSD) formula
mean_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use <- x[x <= 1 & x > 0.05]
  return(mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}

set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

RRF_GCMS_superior0 <- gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"
RRF_GCMS_superior0 <- RRF_GCMS_superior0[RRF_GCMS_superior0 > 0]

# Apply Part 18 formula for database
UF <- 1/(1-rsd_filtered(RRF_GCMS_superior0))

for (i in 1:N_sim) {

## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.6)
simulated_RRF <- sample(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL", size = N_extractables, replace = FALSE)
## add a normal / lognormal distribution to get a "exp" RRF with some variability e.g 30%
exp_RRF <- simulated_RRF * rnorm(n = N_extractables, 1, 0.3)
exp_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF   # experimental concentration : True concentration with the actual RRF
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * UF             # corrected concentration: Exp * UF (conservative method)
condition <- (simulated_RRF < 0.5) | (simulated_RRF > 2) # RRFlow conditions rescaling factor should be focused only to those compounds which exhibits RRF< 0.5 and RRF>2 
corrected_conc[condition] <- exp_conc[condition] / exp_RRF[condition] # average value of the RRF RRFlow application in extractables amount rescaling ( The average RRF determined by the RRFlow will be used to re-calculate the amount of the corresponding compound detected in the extractables study , will assume that it is in the linearity range) 

  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

 iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "RRFlow",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = UF
  )
  )

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "RRFlow",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)

```

## Correction RRF\<1

```{r}


# RSD of the filtered RRF dataset (0.05 < RRF ≤ 1) — avoids negative UF from extreme outliers
rsd_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use = x[x<=1&x>0.05]
  return(sd(x_use, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}
# Mean of the filtered RRF dataset — used in the extended UF(mean·RSD) formula
mean_filtered <- function(x) {
  x_use <- x[x <= 1 & x > 0.05]
  return(mean(x_use, na.rm = TRUE))
}

set.seed(123)
N_sim <- 10000

N_extractables <- 80
total_FN <- 0
total_FP <- 0
total_TP <- 0
total_TN <- 0

RRF_GCMS_superior0 <- gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"
RRF_GCMS_superior0 <- RRF_GCMS_superior0[RRF_GCMS_superior0 > 0]

# Apply Part 18 formula for database
UF <- 1/(1-rsd_filtered(RRF_GCMS_superior0))

for (i in 1:N_sim) {

## 2) Concentration from the log-normal distribution
base_conc_sim <- rlnorm(N_extractables, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.6)
simulated_RRF <- sample(gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL", size = N_extractables, replace = FALSE)
## add a normal / lognormal distribution to get a "exp" RRF with some variability e.g 30%
exp_RRF <- simulated_RRF * rnorm(n = N_extractables, 1, 0.3)
exp_conc <- base_conc_sim * simulated_RRF   # experimental concentration : True concentration with the actual RRF
corrected_conc <- exp_conc * UF             # corrected concentration: Exp * UF (conservative method)
condition <- (simulated_RRF < 1)  # Condition only for LOW responders
corrected_conc[condition] <- exp_conc[condition] / exp_RRF[condition] # average value of the RRF RRFlow application in extractables amount rescaling ( The average RRF determined by the RRFlow will be used to re-calculate the amount of the corresponding compound detected in the extractables study , will assume that it is in the linearity range) 

  is_at_and_above_threshold <- base_conc_sim >= AET
  reported_at_and_above_threshold <- corrected_conc >= AET

 iter_TP <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FP <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_FN <- sum(is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  iter_TN <- sum(!is_at_and_above_threshold & !reported_at_and_above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

  total_TP <- total_TP + iter_TP
  total_FP <- total_FP + iter_FP
  total_FN <- total_FN + iter_FN
  total_TN <- total_TN + iter_TN


  iter_prec <- if((iter_TP + iter_FP) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FP) else 0
  iter_rec  <- if((iter_TP + iter_FN) > 0) iter_TP / (iter_TP + iter_FN) else 0
  
  iter_ActualPos <- iter_TP + iter_FN
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP

  iter_fnr <- if(iter_ActualPos > 0) iter_FN / iter_ActualPos else 0
  iter_fpr <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_FP / iter_ActualNeg else 0
  
  dist_fnr[i] <- iter_fnr * 100
  dist_fpr[i] <- iter_fpr * 100
  
  iter_f1 <- if((iter_prec + iter_rec) > 0) {
    (2 * iter_prec * iter_rec) / (iter_prec + iter_rec)
  } else { 0 }
  
  denom_beta <- (beta^2 * iter_prec) + iter_rec
  iter_fbeta <- if(denom_beta > 0) {
    ((1 + beta^2) * (iter_prec * iter_rec)) / denom_beta
  } else { 0 }
  
  dist_f1[i]   <- iter_f1
  dist_f5[i]   <- iter_fbeta
  
  iter_ActualNeg <- iter_TN + iter_FP
  iter_Total     <- iter_TP + iter_FP + iter_FN + iter_TN
  iter_spec      <- if(iter_ActualNeg > 0) iter_TN / iter_ActualNeg else 0}

count_Above_AET <- total_TP + total_FN
count_Below_AET  <- total_TN + total_FP
FN_Rate_final <- total_FN / count_Above_AET
FP_Rate_final <- total_FP / count_Below_AET

recall <- total_TP / count_Above_AET
precision <- total_TP / (total_TP + total_FP)

F1 <- (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
beta <- 5
f_beta <- (1 + beta^2) * (precision * recall) / ((beta^2 * precision) + recall)

SD_FN <- sqrt(FN_Rate_final * (1 - FN_Rate_final) / count_Above_AET)
SD_FP <- sqrt(FP_Rate_final * (1 - FP_Rate_final) / count_Below_AET)

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  summary_table,
  data.frame(
    Method = "RRF<1",
    FN_Rate = FN_Rate_final,
    FP_Rate = FP_Rate_final,
    FN_SD = SD_FN,
    FP_SD = SD_FP,
    precision = precision,
    recall = recall,
    F1 = F1,
    f_beta = f_beta,
    # Absolute Counts and UF
    is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Above_AET,
    X.is_at_and_above_threshold = count_Below_AET,
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = UF
  )
)
metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "RRF<1",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)
```

## Machine Learning

Loading the ML Model

```{python}
try:
    import joblib
except ImportError:
    joblib = None
import pandas as pd
import os

# Attempt to load the model and the feature list
# This try-except block allows the script to run locally even if binary assets are missing
try:
    model = joblib.load('../../models/rf_rrf_model_final_20.joblib')
    feats = joblib.load('../../models/features_20.joblib')
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Notice: ML model loading failed ({e}). Falling back to unit-RRF predictions.")
    model = None
    feats = None

def predict_rrf_raw(df):
    if model is None or feats is None:
        # Return Neutral RRF (1.0) if model is missing to avoid stopping simulation
        return [1.0] * len(df)
    return model.predict(df[feats])
```

```{r}
    reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TP + total_FP,
    X.reported_at_and_above_threshold = total_TN + total_FN,
    perc_is_at_and_above_threshold = (count_Above_AET / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    perc_reported_at_and_above_threshold = ((total_TP + total_FP) / (count_Above_AET + count_Below_AET)) * 100,
    UF = NA_real_
  )
)

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Method = "Machine Learning",
  F1 = dist_f1,
  F5 = dist_f5,
  Percent_FN = dist_fnr,
  Percent_FP = dist_fpr
)

all_distributions <- rbind(all_distributions, metrics_df)
```

# Confusion Matrices (Average over 10,000 iterations)

```{r}
# 4-column method ordering (groups: fixed-UF | RSD-UF | Percentile | RRF/ML)
method_levels_4col <- c(
  "No Correction",
  "UF (2)",
  "UF (4)",
  "UF (10)",
  "UF (RSD)",
  "UF (RSD filtered)",
  "UF (µRSD)",
  "UF (µRSD filtered)",
  "µ/Percentile (16th)",
  "Percentile 10th",
  "Percentile 20th",
  "RRFlow",
  "RRF<1",
  "Machine Learning"
)

N_sim <- 10000

# Column guide (sums over N_sim iterations):
#   is_at_and_above_threshold        = total_TP + total_FN  (all actual positives)
#   X.is_at_and_above_threshold      = total_TN + total_FP  (all actual negatives)
#   reported_at_and_above_threshold  = total_TP + total_FP  (all predicted positives)
#   recall                           = total_TP / actual_positives
cm_data <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    total_grand = is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold,
    TP = recall * is_at_and_above_threshold,
    FN = is_at_and_above_threshold - TP,
    FP = reported_at_and_above_threshold - TP,
    TN = X.is_at_and_above_threshold - FP,
    # Percentage of grand total
    pct_TP = round(TP / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_FP = round(FP / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_FN = round(FN / total_grand * 100, 1),
    pct_TN = round(TN / total_grand * 100, 1),
    # Average count per simulation (out of 80 compounds)
    avg_TP = round(TP / N_sim),
    avg_FP = round(FP / N_sim),
    avg_FN = round(FN / N_sim),
    avg_TN = round(TN / N_sim)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Method, pct_TP, pct_FP, pct_FN, pct_TN,
                         avg_TP, avg_FP, avg_FN, avg_TN)

# ── Per-iteration SD from all_distributions ───────────────────────────────────
cm_sd_base <- all_distributions %>%
  left_join(
    summary_table %>%
      transmute(
        Method,
        total_grand_per_sim = (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold) / N_sim,
        actual_pos_frac     = is_at_and_above_threshold /
          (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold),
        actual_neg_frac     = X.is_at_and_above_threshold /
          (is_at_and_above_threshold + X.is_at_and_above_threshold),
        actual_pos_per_sim  = is_at_and_above_threshold / N_sim,
        actual_neg_per_sim  = X.is_at_and_above_threshold / N_sim
      ),
    by = "Method"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Per-iteration FN / FP / TP / TN as % of grand total
    sim_pct_FN = (Percent_FN / 100) * actual_pos_frac * 100,
    sim_pct_FP = (Percent_FP / 100) * actual_neg_frac * 100,
    sim_pct_TP = actual_pos_frac * 100 - sim_pct_FN,
    sim_pct_TN = actual_neg_frac * 100 - sim_pct_FP,
    # Per-iteration FN / FP / TP / TN as counts (out of 80)
    sim_FN = (Percent_FN / 100) * actual_pos_per_sim,
    sim_FP = (Percent_FP / 100) * actual_neg_per_sim,
    sim_TP = actual_pos_per_sim - sim_FN,
    sim_TN = actual_neg_per_sim - sim_FP
  ) %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarize(
    # % SDs
    sd_pct_TP = round(sd(sim_pct_TP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_FP = round(sd(sim_pct_FP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_FN = round(sd(sim_pct_FN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_pct_TN = round(sd(sim_pct_TN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    # Count SDs
    sd_avg_TP = round(sd(sim_TP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_FP = round(sd(sim_FP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_FN = round(sd(sim_FN, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_avg_TN = round(sd(sim_TN, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

cm_tile_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        axis.text       = element_text(size = 9),
        panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"))

cm_fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(
  values = c("TP" = "#2E86AB", "TN" = "#2E86AB",
             "FN" = "#E84855", "FP" = "#F4A261"),
  guide = guide_legend(title = "Cell type")
)
```

# Practical Implementability of the Estimated AET

The previous sections rank the correction methods only by their statistical performance (FN/FP, F-scores). A method can look excellent on those metrics yet be impossible to run on a real instrument. The reason is structural: in ISO 10993-18 the uncertainty factor sits in the **denominator** of the AET, so every correction implicitly lowers the threshold a compound must clear. Following the thesis derivation $$AET_{\text{estimated}}=T^{*}=\frac{AET_{\text{true}}}{UF},$$ the *implied* (estimated) AET is just the working AET of this notebook divided by each method's UF. When that estimated AET drops to the method's limit of quantification (LOQ) or limit of detection (LOD), the filter can no longer be operated; when it approaches zero, the filter passes every detected peak and therefore stops filtering at all. For GC/MS the FDA permits a default UF of 4 without further justification.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Assumptions (stated explicitly)

- **Technique: GC/MS**, with **LOQ = 0.2 µg/mL** (the value used for left-censoring the pooled study in this work) and **LOD = LOQ / 3 \~ 0.067 µg/mL** (standard S/N relationship). The LOD is an assumption, not a measurement.

- **Detectability is read from a large sample** of this notebook's own true-concentration model, so no closed-form distribution is assumed.

- Any method whose estimated UF is \<= 0 (possible when the RRF RSD exceeds 1) makes the ISO formula undefined; it is flagged, not plotted.

- **Machine Learning** uses a per-compound predicted RRF, not a single UF, so it has no single estimated AET and is left out here.
:::

```{r}
#| label: implied-aet-setup
# 1) Sensitivity floors for this technique (µg/mL)
LOQ_meth <- 0.2
LOD_meth <- LOQ_meth / 3            # assumed: LOD is about one third of LOQ

# 2) A big sample of the TRUE concentration, drawn from the same model this
#    notebook uses. We read detectability straight off this sample.
set.seed(2024)
big_n <- 2000000
true_conc_ref <- rlnorm(big_n, meanlog = -2.4, sdlog = 4.6)
p_detect <- mean(true_conc_ref >= LOQ_meth)   # share of compounds at or above LOQ

# 3) The RRF values this notebook samples from (used for the percentile question)
rrf_pool <- gcms_clap_clean$"5 µg/mL"
rrf_pool <- rrf_pool[rrf_pool > 0]

# 4) AET scenarios to show (each comes from a different DBT / device / volume case)
aet_scenarios <- c(0.45, 3, 6, 36)

# 5) Colours for the four feasibility classes
feas_levels <- c("Feasible (>= LOQ)", "Borderline (LOD-LOQ)",
                 "Infeasible (< LOD)", "Undefined (UF <= 0)")
feas_cols <- c("Feasible (>= LOQ)"    = "#009E73",
               "Borderline (LOD-LOQ)" = "#E69F00",
               "Infeasible (< LOD)"   = "#D55E00",
               "Undefined (UF <= 0)"  = "#999999")
# Colour-blind-safe shape encoding (redundant with colour) — Elsevier accessibility
feas_shapes <- c("Feasible (>= LOQ)"    = 16,
                 "Borderline (LOD-LOQ)" = 17,
                 "Infeasible (< LOD)"   = 15,
                 "Undefined (UF <= 0)"  = 4)

# 6) One row per method (drop ML). A UF that is zero or negative becomes NA,
#    because the ISO formula has no meaning there.
uf_tbl <- summary_table[summary_table$Method != "Machine Learning",
                        c("Method", "UF", "FN_Rate")]
uf_tbl$UF_ok  <- ifelse(is.finite(uf_tbl$UF) & uf_tbl$UF > 0, uf_tbl$UF, NA)
uf_tbl$FN_pct <- round(uf_tbl$FN_Rate * 100, 1)

# 7) Method x scenario grid: estimated AET = AET_true / UF
grid <- expand.grid(Method = uf_tbl$Method, AET_true = aet_scenarios,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
implied_long <- merge(grid, uf_tbl, by = "Method")
implied_long$implied_AET <- implied_long$AET_true / implied_long$UF_ok
implied_long$feasibility <- ifelse(
  is.na(implied_long$implied_AET), "Undefined (UF <= 0)", ifelse(
  implied_long$implied_AET >= LOQ_meth, "Feasible (>= LOQ)", ifelse(
  implied_long$implied_AET >= LOD_meth, "Borderline (LOD-LOQ)",
                                        "Infeasible (< LOD)")))
implied_long$feasibility <- factor(implied_long$feasibility, levels = feas_levels)
implied_long$Method <- factor(implied_long$Method, levels = method_levels)
```

## Table -- Estimated AET and analytical feasibility (focal AET)

`UF` is the estimated uncertainty factor; `FN_%` its false-negative rate; `Implied_AET = AET / UF`; `T*/LOQ` and `T*/LOD` show the head-room above the floors (values \< 1 mean the threshold is below that floor). `Filter_retained_%` is the share of detectable compounds (true conc \>= LOQ) the estimated AET still removes -- at 0 % the filter reports every detected peak.

```{r}
#| label: implied-aet-table
tab <- uf_tbl
tab$Implied_AET <- round(AET / tab$UF_ok, 4)
tab$T_over_LOQ  <- round(tab$Implied_AET / LOQ_meth, 2)
tab$T_over_LOD  <- round(tab$Implied_AET / LOD_meth, 2)

# Share of detectable peaks the estimated AET still removes (plain loop)
tab$Filter_retained_pct <- NA_real_
for (i in 1:nrow(tab)) {
  t_star <- tab$Implied_AET[i]
  if (!is.na(t_star)) {
    removed <- mean(true_conc_ref >= LOQ_meth & true_conc_ref < t_star)
    tab$Filter_retained_pct[i] <- round(removed / p_detect * 100, 1)
  }
}

tab$Verdict <- ifelse(
  is.na(tab$UF_ok), "Undefined (UF <= 0): rejects all", ifelse(
  tab$Implied_AET >= LOQ_meth, "Feasible", ifelse(
  tab$Implied_AET >= LOD_meth, "Borderline",
                               "Filter nullified (< LOD)")))

implied_table <- tab[order(-tab$UF),
                     c("Method", "UF", "FN_pct", "Implied_AET",
                       "T_over_LOQ", "T_over_LOD", "Filter_retained_pct",
                       "Verdict")]
implied_table$UF <- round(implied_table$UF, 3)

knitr::kable(implied_table,
             col.names = c("Method", "UF", "FN_%", "Implied_AET",
                           "T*/LOQ", "T*/LOD", "Filter_retained_%", "Verdict"),
             row.names = FALSE, align = "lrrrrrrl",
             caption = paste0("Estimated AET = ", AET, " / UF, against LOQ = ",
                              LOQ_meth, " and LOD = ", round(LOD_meth, 3),
                              " µg/mL."))
```

## Viz 1 -- Estimated AET vs the analytical instrumental limit (focal AET)

Lollipop on a log scale. Points right of the green LOQ line are feasible; points in the orange band (LOD-LOQ) are borderline; points left of the red LOD line collapse the filter. Each point shows its UF and FN rate.

```{r}

                       !is.na(implied_long$implied_AET), ]
viz1 <- droplevels(viz1)
viz1$Method <- reorder(viz1$Method, viz1$implied_AET)

.p_out <- ggplot(viz1, aes(x = implied_AET, y = Method)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = LOD_meth, xmax = LOQ_meth,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#E69F00", alpha = 0.12) +

  annotate("text", x = LOD_meth, y = 0.6, label = "LOD", colour = "#D55E00",
           hjust = 1.1, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = "Estimated AET per correction method vs analytical instrumental limit",
       subtitle = paste0("AET = ", AET, " µg/mL | estimated AET = AET / UF"),
       x = "Estimated AET, T* (µg/mL, log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +

.p_out
```

## Viz 3 -- When the filter stops filtering

Left: as UF grows, the estimated AET falls along `T* = AET / UF`; in the red zone (below LOQ) it is no longer usable. Right: the share of detectable peaks the filter still removes (0 % = filter nullified).

```{r}
#| label: implied-aet-nullification
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
#| warning: false
pts <- implied_table[!is.na(implied_table$Implied_AET), ]
pts$feasibility <- ifelse(
  pts$Implied_AET >= LOQ_meth, "Feasible (>= LOQ)", ifelse(
  pts$Implied_AET >= LOD_meth, "Borderline (LOD-LOQ)",
                               "Infeasible (< LOD)"))
pts$feasibility <- factor(pts$feasibility, levels = feas_levels)

uf_max  <- max(pts$UF, na.rm = TRUE)
uf_grid <- data.frame(UF = 10^seq(0, log10(uf_max * 1.3), length.out = 200))
uf_grid$implied_AET <- AET / uf_grid$UF

p_curve <- ggplot(uf_grid, aes(UF, implied_AET)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = LOQ_meth,
           fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.10) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LOQ_meth, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#009E73") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LOD_meth, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#D55E00") +
  geom_point(data = pts, aes(UF, Implied_AET, colour = feasibility, shape = feasibility), size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = pts,
                           aes(UF, Implied_AET,
                               label = paste0(Method, " (UF ", round(UF, 1),
                                              ", FN ", FN_pct, "%)")),
                           size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.4) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = feas_cols, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = feas_shapes, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Estimated AET collapses as UF grows",
       subtitle = "Red zone = below LOQ (not analytically usable)",
       x = "Uncertainty factor, UF (log scale)",
       y = "Estimated AET, T* (µg/mL, log)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

bar_dat <- pts
bar_dat$Method <- reorder(bar_dat$Method, bar_dat$Filter_retained_pct)
p_bar <- ggplot(bar_dat, aes(Filter_retained_pct, Method, fill = feasibility)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Filter_retained_pct), "%")),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = feas_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Feasibility") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Filtering power retained",
       subtitle = "% of detectable peaks still screened out (0 % = nullified)",
       x = "Detectable peaks removed by the estimated AET (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

p_curve + p_bar + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))
```

## Viz 4 -- Which RRF percentile reaches the LOQ and the LOD?

For a percentile-type correction the estimated AET equals `AET x (chosen RRF percentile)`. So we can ask directly: which percentile of the RRF distribution lands exactly on the LOQ, and which on the LOD? The two methods actually tested (Percentile 10th and 20th) are marked, so it is easy to see whether they clear the floors or fall short.

```{r}
#| label: implied-aet-percentile
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
# Estimated AET for every percentile from 1 to 99
pct_seq <- 1:99
rrf_at_pct <- quantile(rrf_pool, probs = pct_seq / 100, names = FALSE)
perc_curve <- data.frame(percentile = pct_seq, implied_AET = AET * rrf_at_pct)

# Percentile needed to reach each floor (share of RRFs below the target value)
pct_for_LOQ <- round(mean(rrf_pool <= LOQ_meth / AET) * 100, 1)
pct_for_LOD <- round(mean(rrf_pool <= LOD_meth / AET) * 100, 1)

# Resulting UF at each floor. Because estimated AET = AET / UF, the UF that lands
# exactly on a floor is simply AET / floor (it does not depend on the RRFs).
uf_for_LOQ <- round(AET / LOQ_meth, 1)
uf_for_LOD <- round(AET / LOD_meth, 1)

# The two percentile methods the thesis evaluates, with their resulting UF
# (for a percentile correction, UF = 1 / chosen RRF percentile)
used_pct <- data.frame(
  percentile  = c(10, 20),
  implied_AET = AET * quantile(rrf_pool, c(0.10, 0.20), names = FALSE),
  UF          = round(1 / quantile(rrf_pool, c(0.10, 0.20), names = FALSE), 1),
  label       = c("Percentile 10th", "Percentile 20th"))
used_pct$label <- paste0(used_pct$label, " (UF ", used_pct$UF, ")")

# Reference point at UF = 4
pct_at_uf4 <- round(mean(rrf_pool <= 1 / 4) * 100, 1)
ref_uf_pt <- data.frame(
  percentile  = pct_at_uf4,
  implied_AET = AET / 4,
  label       = paste0("UF = 4 (", pct_at_uf4, "th percentile)"))

y_top <- max(perc_curve$implied_AET)

.p_out <- ggplot(perc_curve, aes(percentile, implied_AET)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = LOQ_meth,
           fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LOQ_meth, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#009E73") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = LOD_meth, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#D55E00") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pct_for_LOQ, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#009E73") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pct_for_LOD, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#D55E00") +
  geom_point(data = used_pct, aes(percentile, implied_AET),
             colour = "#D55E00", size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = used_pct,
                           aes(percentile, implied_AET, label = label),
                           size = 4.5, box.padding = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = ref_uf_pt, aes(percentile, implied_AET),
             colour = "steelblue", size = 3, shape = 17) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = ref_uf_pt,
                           aes(percentile, implied_AET, label = label),
                           size = 4.5, box.padding = 0.5, colour = "steelblue") +
  annotate("text", x = pct_for_LOQ, y = y_top,
           label = paste0("need >= ", pct_for_LOQ, "th percentile for LOQ (UF: ", uf_for_LOQ, ")"),
           colour = "#009E73", hjust = -0.03, vjust = 1, size = 4.2) +
  annotate("text", x = pct_for_LOD, y = y_top,
           label = paste0("need >= ", pct_for_LOD, "th percentile for LOD (UF: ", uf_for_LOD, ")"),
           colour = "#D55E00", hjust = -0.03, vjust = 2.6, size = 4.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "RRF percentile and analytical instrumental limit",
       subtitle = paste0("AET = ",
                         AET, " µg/mL"),
       x = "RRF percentile used as the conservative estimate (%)",
       y = "Estimated AET (µg/mL, log)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 13))
.p_out
ggsave(paste0(fig_tag, "_Fig_feas_percentile.tiff"), plot = .p_out, width = 140, height = 90, units = "mm", dpi = 500, device = "tiff", type = "cairo", compression = "lzw", bg = "white")  # Elsevier TIFF
```
